annotation.title_clean: CCW/GGE.1/2024/WP.3: Elements of an instrument and other possible measures to address emerging technologies in the area of lethal autonomous weapons systems
annotation.title_en: CCW/GGE.1/2024/WP.3: Elements of an instrument and other possible measures to address emerging technologies in the area of lethal autonomous weapons systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bulgaria, Denmark, France, Germany, Italy et al. (submitted to the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS)
annotation.venue: UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW), Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS
annotation.summary_en: Working paper by Bulgaria, Denmark, France, Germany, Italy and others to the CCW GGE proposing elements of a two-tiered instrument on lethal autonomous weapons: prohibit inherently indiscriminate or uncontrollable systems, and regulate other LAWS through IHL compliance, testing, human control, risk mitigation and state accountability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Two-tiered approach: prohibit certain LAWS and restrict all others.
Prohibits LAWS that are indiscriminate, uncontrollable in effects, outside human control and chain of command, or cause superfluous injury.
Requires legal assessment, testing, certification and operator training for permitted LAWS.
Mandates retained human control across the life cycle, with limits on targets, duration, geography and scale.
States remain responsible; individual IHL responsibility cannot be transferred to machines; national accountability mechanisms required.
